safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Decrease SAP safety lead time from 4.0 to 2.8 days

narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for PL1__MCB20CA0 reveals moderate demand with mean daily demand of 373.8 units (CV=0.33). Lead time averages 4.0 days with moderate variability (CV=0.39). Recommended policy: Safety stock of 1049 units, reorder point of 2552 units, order quantity of 2010 units. This provides 95.0% service level protection. The optimized policy incurs an additional annual cost of $1,575.93 versus the current SAP zero-safety-stock configuration, a necessary investment to eliminate stockout risk.
warnings: Lead time data contained 2 extreme outliers (> 11.8 days) which were removed

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand CV=0.33 indicates moderate, non-intermittent daily demand suitable for normal approximation under a continuous-review policy. Lead time CV=0.39 shows moderate variability captured by the combined-variance safety stock formula.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap binds: unconstrained EOQ of 3,527 is reduced to 2,010 due to max_storage_units=3,059.85. This increases ordering frequency slightly but maintains physical feasibility. Service level is preserved; ordering cost increases marginally.
research_insights.escalation_flag: None — MOQ (222) + safety stock (1,049) = 1,271 units, which is below max_storage_units (3,059.85). No infeasibility conflict.
